prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-05):
| Return 3m            | +8.4% |
| Return 1m            | +10.8% |
| Return 1w            | -0.1% |
| Range position (63d) | 89% |
| 21d realized vol     | 28% |
| Last close           | 48.77 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows positive medium-term momentum (3m +8.4%, 1m +10.8%), with a modest near-term dip (-0.1% last week that could be a pullback within an uptrend). A tight range position (89% over 63 days) suggests the price can continue to drift within a constructive range, supporting a cautious upside tilt. Given the balance of indicators, the distribution favors further gains over the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
